summary.text: Rick Eldridge is a Republican state representative from Tennessee's District 10 who took office on November 6, 2018.
He advanced from the August 6, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2023-2024 session, Eldridge served on the Civil Justice Committee and was vice chair of the State Government Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
He was unopposed in the 2026 Republican primary, receiving 5,872 votes.
